quest.514D1112BAB39A83.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Iron Pickaxe (minecraft:iron_pickaxe). The items are not consumed by this task.
Have in your inventory 64 × Cobblestone (minecraft:cobblestone). The items are not consumed by this task.

Use an iron pickaxe and FTB Ultimine to successfully break at least two different blocks in one grouped operation. Ordinary mining does not count. The separate item tasks detect the pickaxe and 64 cobblestone without consuming them. Check Controls for FTB Ultimine and preview the selected area before breaking it.
quest.514D1112BAB39A83.title: Mine a Group with Ultimine

quest.514D1118E4523B29.title: Opened Chance Cube: 1
quest.514D111AFD4E2789.quest_desc: Prepare a compass, 32 torches and a water bucket. The item tasks check inventory without consuming anything; also bring food, tool durability and a marked return route.

Then choose any discoveries available around you. The compass points to its vanilla target and does not locate structures automatically. Visiting a particular bridge, village, tavern or biome is not required to continue the quests.
quest.514D111AFD4E2789.title: A Small Expedition Kit
quest.514D113C4B748351.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Chance Cube (chancecubes:chance_cube). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.514D113C4B748351.title: Obtain 1 × Chance Cube
quest.514D11628A7DD0E1.quest_desc: Optional expedition: find a generated Abridged bridge and enter its structure. A player-built bridge does not satisfy the location check.

The reward remains available, but this visit unlocks and blocks no later quest. If the bridge is far away, continue preparation, trading and other objectives. In an existing explored world, look for newly added structures in new chunks.
quest.514D11628A7DD0E1.title: Visit Bridge
quest.514D11824471BA9B.title: Enter The End
quest.514D118E5C7AB43A.quest_desc: After the equipment and workshop summary, hold a compass in your inventory. The task does not consume it or require any particular generated location.
Trading, structure visits and opening a Chance Cube are separate optional activities. Choose them when useful and return to production when you have the materials you need.
quest.514D118E5C7AB43A.title: Expedition Checklist
quest.514D11A7ED9AA3BB.quest_desc: Complete the expedition kit and Industrial Chassis quests. These are the two conditions for this summary: equipment for a return journey and a prepared workshop.

The summary completes automatically from those dependencies. No particular bridge, underground village or tavern must be found. Mark your base and chosen direction on the map; building a road remains your own project.
quest.514D11A7ED9AA3BB.title: Equipment and Workshop Ready
quest.514D11B7AEB78396.title: Enter The Nether
quest.514D11CDA1129F03.quest_desc: Optional expedition: enter a real Underground Village. This generated structure is separate from Millénaire settlements.

Prepare a lit route back to the surface. The visit is detected automatically within the structure. Trading and expedition readiness are available without this visit; dismantling the village or moving its villagers is unnecessary.
quest.514D11CDA1129F03.title: Visit Underground Village
quest.514D11E0ED42C1FF.quest_desc: Complete a normal villager trade to earn the vanilla What a Deal! advancement. A trader in a surface village or at your base can satisfy it.
An Underground Village is not required: this optional branch opens after the expedition kit. Trading does not block the readiness summary or later expeditions.
quest.514D11E0ED42C1FF.title: Trade with Any Villager
quest.514E110000000001.quest_desc: Obtain the Dimensional Dungeons Patchouli guidebook. Right-click it and find the portal, key and puzzle sections. This task recognizes that specific book by its contents; keep it in your inventory.

This is an optional expedition branch. All twelve quests remain separate from the main production route, and each member claims each quest reward personally once. Item objectives check your inventory and leave the items with you.

Prepare food, armor, weapons and spare inventory space. This pack's dungeons include ordinary DivineRPG and Twilight Forest enemies with additional Elite Mobs abilities and Apotheosis augments. Start with a short scouting trip and keep track of the entrance.
quest.514E110000000001.title: Dungeon Guidebook
quest.514E110000000002.quest_desc: Prepare one Portal Keyhole and two Gilded Portal Blocks. You need to craft three gilded blocks in total: one is an ingredient of the keyhole, while two remain for the frame. Check the recipes in JEI.

Add nine valid stone-brick blocks for the structure itself. Open the guidebook's multiblock diagram: the complete frame is seven blocks wide and four blocks high. Follow its placement of the keyhole, two gilded blocks and stone bricks.
This quest checks the two item types in your inventory before construction. A later visit objective records actual entry through the portal; keep the frame for return expeditions.
quest.514E110000000002.quest_subtitle: A keyhole and two gilded portal blocks
quest.514E110000000002.title: Portal Components
quest.514E110000000003.quest_desc: Craft a blank basic key from a name tag and a blaze rod using the JEI recipe. This inventory objective accepts the portal-key item, including an already activated key; the next quest checks the activation ritual itself.

Each newly activated key receives its own dungeon destination. Keep found and used keys: opening the portal with the same key returns to the same place, preserving the value of your route markers and solved rooms.
Craft a separate spare blank key for the Homeward Pearl recipe. This keeps the key for your current expedition available to reopen its portal.
quest.514E110000000003.title: A Blank Dungeon Key
quest.514E110000000004.quest_desc: Find an End Portal Frame without an eye and use the blank basic key on the central hole of its top face. Aim at the hole itself. If the frame contains an eye, the first interaction breaks it; repeat the ritual on the empty hole afterwards.

A Key Enscriber found in a dungeon is another valid activation method. Its separate quest opens after your first visit. A successful ritual earns the native basic-key activation advancement used by this objective.
Use the activated key in your frame's Portal Keyhole and check that a passage opens. Keep this key: activating a different key creates a new destination.
quest.514E110000000004.quest_subtitle: The empty End Portal Frame ritual
quest.514E110000000004.title: Activate a Basic Key
quest.514E110000000005.quest_desc: Walk through your open portal and remember the dungeon entrance. This objective uses the native first-visit advancement for the Dimensional Dungeons dimension. It records entry into the shared dimension; clearing every room and proving a particular key type are not its conditions.

Read room clues, operate their mechanisms and solve puzzles according to the dungeon's rules. Some enemies carry key items; retain guaranteed keys from their drops. In this pack, basic and advanced rooms can also contain empowered ordinary DivineRPG and Twilight Forest mobs.

Separate keys lead to the Nether Fortress, Desert and Sewers themes. These keys are usually already activated and may drop from an enemy's offhand. Entering the shared dimension does not identify a particular theme; use each key's description and retain the destination for expeditions you want to revisit.
quest.514E110000000005.title: First Dungeon Visit
quest.514E110000000006.quest_desc: Craft a Homeward Pearl using the JEI recipe and a separate spare blank key. Hold the pearl in your inventory; this item check leaves it with you.

Using the pearl inside a dungeon consumes it and returns you to that dungeon's entrance. From there, use the normal exit. It does not teleport directly to your base, so remember where you built the outside portal.
Keep the pearl in an accessible slot before a longer scouting trip. Check your equipment at the entrance and continue with enough food and durability.
quest.514E110000000006.title: Homeward Pearl
quest.514E110000000007.quest_desc: Find and obtain a Dimensional Dungeons Key Enscriber. The native advancement accepts any one of its fresh, used or damaged states. You do not need all three at once.

The enscriber provides another way to activate blank keys. Read its guidebook page and check the block's condition before further rituals. This quest records obtaining an enscriber; basic-key activation has its own objective.
Mark where you found it and keep the key for that dungeon. Its saved destination lets you revisit familiar rooms and continue looking for secrets.
quest.514E110000000007.quest_subtitle: A fresh, used or damaged Key Enscriber
quest.514E110000000007.title: Find a Key Enscriber
quest.514E110000000008.quest_desc: Obtain a Bell of Secrets during your dungeon expeditions. Its native advancement records the required bell entering your inventory and remembers the find.
Open the bell's guidebook page and use it while inspecting suspicious rooms. Secret hunting complements reading clues and solving puzzles; look carefully along routes you already know.
This quest records finding the tool. Collecting the eight different trophies has its own saved conditions and a separate reward.
quest.514E110000000008.title: Find a Secret Bell
quest.514E110000000009.quest_desc: Look for a Blank Advanced Key in keyholes inside dungeons and take it into your inventory. Finding this blank earns the native advancement for this quest.

Activate the blank through a valid ritual on an empty End Portal Frame or with a Key Enscriber. The result uses the same portal-key item while storing the advanced-dungeon flag and its own destination. Check the key's description before inserting it.
Prepare the upgraded frame with two crowns and the required banners as well. The key and crown quests are independent after your first expedition and join before advanced entry.
quest.514E110000000009.quest_subtitle: Find the blank and prepare its activation
quest.514E110000000009.title: An Advanced Key Blank
quest.514E11000000000A.quest_desc: Find two Portal Crowns and hold both in your inventory at the same time. This native advancement checks a count of two; place the crowns after the find has been recorded.

Upgrade the ordinary frame using the guidebook's advanced diagram: place two crowns and a valid white or purple wall banner on each outer pillar. Match the orientation and block positions to the multiblock preview.
The crowns and banners prepare the portal for an activated advanced key. Separate themed keys lead to the Nether Fortress, Desert or Sewers variants, as described by their tooltips.
quest.514E11000000000A.quest_subtitle: Two crowns and banners for advanced entry
quest.514E11000000000A.title: Two Portal Crowns
quest.514E11000000000B.quest_desc: After finding the blank and two crowns, activate the advanced key, check the upgraded frame and insert the key into its keyhole. Walk through the open portal to earn the native advanced-entry advancement.

This objective confirms entry into an advanced dungeon. Defeating every enemy, opening every chest and finishing every puzzle remain goals for your expedition, so plan around your equipment and supplies.

This pack's advanced rooms have stronger ordinary enemy pools and larger additional attribute bonuses. Bring a Homeward Pearl, retain the key and inspect the route back to the entrance before a long fight.

Beyond advanced dungeons, SOQM adds Iron Citadel and Obsidian Abyss expeditions. Look for a Citadel key in hard Advanced treasure and an Abyss key in the Citadel's locked treasuries. Both keys are already activated and require the upgraded portal frame. The guidebook's new SOQM Expeditions section explains the route and preparation.
quest.514E11000000000B.quest_subtitle: Travel with an activated advanced key
quest.514E11000000000B.title: Enter an Advanced Dungeon
quest.514E11000000000C.quest_desc: Collect all eight different Dimensional Dungeons trophies. Each type has its own criterion in the native advancement; obtaining a trophy in your inventory saves that part of the collection.

You can finish the collection across many expeditions. You do not need to hold all eight items at once. Check the advancement for missing trophy types and follow the guidebook and room clues while searching for them.
This is a long optional goal after the first dungeon visit. Completing the collection grants one personal quest reward, while the main production route stays available at your own exploration pace.
quest.514E11000000000C.quest_subtitle: Collect all eight different trophies over time
quest.514E11000000000C.title: Eight Dungeon Trophies
